'''Desto Mayda''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from [[Garos IV]]. He had a son [[Jos Mayda|Jos]]. In [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] established an official presence on Garos IV. Desto Mayda was on of the first Garosian to join the [[Committee of Seven for Garosian Unification|resistance]]. He was quickly revealed as a rebel and wanted by the Empire. This forced him to cut all relations with his son who was furious about his father because he planned to join the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]]. However, Jos was killed by the Empire and Desto convinced his son's best friend, [[Dair Haslip]], to enter the Imperial [[Raithal Academy/Legends|academy]] as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]].
